## Abstract

My PhD dissertation is a collection of essays in energy economics, developed in the Graduate Program in Organizations and Markets at the Federal University of Pelotas (UFPel), under the supervision of Daniel de Abreu Pereira Uhr.

Draft chapters will be posted on this page as they reach working-paper stage.

## Status

In progress (2023–).
